New ways to see, share and celebrate your folds.

• Personal insights: discover your daily average, busiest folding day and hour, and how your latest week compares with the one before it.
• Made to share: create beautifully styled images of your lifetime count, today’s folds, seven-day chart, 30-day calendar or personal insights. Save them or share them through the iOS share sheet.
• Milestones now include your Earlier folds estimate, keeping progress in step with your lifetime total.
• A little surprise is hiding in Settings. Not everything is as still as it seems.

Insights use completed days and recorded folds. Weekly comparisons appear after 14 completed days. Everything is calculated on your device.
results.description:
For iPhone Duo only.

Give your Duo an odometer.

You know that satisfying feeling of folding your Duo closed? Now you can put a number on it. FoldTick turns your everyday folds into a beautifully crafted split-flap counter, widgets that feel right at home, and a growing picture of how you use your Duo.

A COUNTER WITH CHARACTER
Watch your lifetime total grow on a graphite split-flap display inspired by mechanical counters. Collect milestones along the way, from your first fold to the next big number.

YOUR COUNT, WHERE YOU WANT IT
Bring FoldTick to your Home Screen and Lock Screen. Choose a compact counter, a medium widget with today and yesterday side by side, or a wide counter that gives the numbers center stage. Show today's folds or your all-time total. Home widgets follow light and dark appearance while their mechanical flaps stay dark.

A HEAD START FOR YOUR COUNTER
Already folded your Duo before installing FoldTick? Add your own estimate in Settings. It’s included in your lifetime total and milestone progress. Daily activity and personal insights stay based on recorded folds. Change the estimate or clear it any time.

SEE HOW YOUR DAY UNFOLDS
Explore your hourly activity, compare the last seven days, and browse a 30-day calendar with a count for every day. Personal insights reveal your daily average, busiest day and hour, and weekly change using up to 30 completed days. Recent activity puts your latest folds into neat time tiles.

SHARE A LITTLE OF YOUR RHYTHM
Turn your lifetime count, today’s folds, seven-day chart, 30-day calendar or personal insights into a beautifully styled image. Save it to Photos or choose where to share it using the iOS share sheet. Nothing is posted automatically.

SET IT UP. LET IT TICK.
New to Shortcuts? The illustrated guide walks you through creating one closing automation in a few simple steps. Once configured, its Record Fold action can keep count while FoldTick is off-screen, including while your Duo is locked after its first unlock.

JUST YOUR FOLDS
No account. No ads. No subscriptions. No analytics service. Your fold history stays on your device, and insights are calculated there too. Sharing is always your choice.

IMPORTANT COMPATIBILITY AND SETUP
FoldTick is designed exclusively for iPhone Duo. Automatic fold counting requires iPhone Duo with iOS 27.1 or later and one enabled closing automation in Apple's Shortcuts app. Other iPhone models do not support the required closing trigger.

Each closing action delivered by Shortcuts adds one fold cycle. Counting starts after setup; earlier folds and actions not delivered by Shortcuts cannot be recovered. Personal insights exclude today, the first recording day and your Earlier folds estimate; weekly comparisons need 14 completed days. Days without received folds count as zero, including when an automation did not run. iOS schedules automatic widget updates, so widgets may lag behind the saved count. Use the widget refresh control to request the latest saved value.

FoldTick is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple. iPhone Duo is a trademark of Apple Inc.
